fusions.name: Two-Way Rebound
fusions.desc: Throws your shield at the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 damage, and it rebounds to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 50% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Tine Catch
fusions.desc: Catches the target's weapon in the forked edge of your guard and wrenches it, dealing 11 damage, stunning it for 1 second and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. It is [Hindered] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Split the Blow
fusions.desc: Raises a forked guard that absorbs the next 20 damage across up to 2 blows, holding for 6 seconds. Your armour rises by 5% while it holds.

fusions.name: Either Way
fusions.desc: Once every 12 seconds, a blow you failed to dodge is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
